items.title: Local SIM and bank
items.detail: Get a SIM on day one, then open a bank account. Everything else depends on these.

items.title: Student ID and registration
items.detail: Finish all university registrations on time.

items.title: Set up groceries
items.detail: Find a nearby store and plan your first week's meals.

items.title: Meet people
items.detail: Seniors, classmates and the Indian community. Don't stay alone.
